_comment: Placeholders only. Configure provider credentials locally using TrueForge or the secure helper; never save real keys here. This is a checklist, not an import manifest.
credentialSetup: Run scripts/configure-groq.ps1 locally. For an optional second provider, set FALLBACK_BASE_URL and FALLBACK_MODEL, optionally set FALLBACK_API_KEY, then run node scripts/configure-fallback.cjs. Credentials are stored by TrueForge, not in this file.
